feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — observability
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Phoenix 20.24.0 tightens dependency security
entry.summary: Arize Phoenix 20.24.0 requires certifi 2026.10.18 to drop the emSign root whose intermediates were compromised, requires Node releases from the October 2026 security release, and excludes a litellm release its changelog describes as compromised.

entry.title: Braintrust evals can run through provider batch APIs
entry.summary: Braintrust eval tasks and scorers can run through OpenAI and Anthropic batch APIs, which those providers price 50% below standard, with results tracked in one experiment. Needs TS SDK 3.37.0+ or Python SDK 0.45.0+.

source.title: Run evals 50% cheaper with workflow evals

entry.title: LangSmith AI Search for agent traces in public beta
entry.summary: LangSmith adds natural-language search over agent traces (for example user frustration or PII leaks) in public beta on LangSmith Cloud in GCP US, EU and APAC; org admins enable it in settings.

source.title: Search agent traces by behavior with AI Search in LangSmith

entry.title: Langfuse — release
entry.summary: Langfuse 4.55 added FIPS-mode Docker images, a Google Cloud Storage export target and batch score ingestion; 4.56.0 adds spend alerts and moves score reads to read replicas.

entry.title: Arize Phoenix — feature
entry.summary: Arize Phoenix 20.20.0 adds a Docker Sandboxes provider and MCP GraphQL tools.

entry.title: Opik — release
entry.summary: Opik 2.2.96 is the latest release; the 2.2.92 line added a free-form SQL post-run check and a native Ollama integration.

entry.title: MLflow — release
entry.summary: MLflow 3.17.0 adds typed judge decisions, fine-grained permissions for shared resources and faster SQL trace analytics. It requires a coordinated database upgrade.

entry.title: MLflow — release
entry.summary: MLflow 3.16.1 removed the default basic-auth admin password (a security fix for self-hosted servers) and added scorer timeouts.
